qs.ours: ♦ "With one consent," ἀπο μιας; this ellipsis may be supplied by γνωμης, φωνης, ὡρας, ψυχης, γλωσσης, or *uItms:* the first word seems to deserve the preference; though Lightfoot's judgment in favour of the last, and deriving it from the verb in juxtaposition, παραιτεισθαι, is very ingenious, and deserving of consideration.
